reason: The surgical cut-mode recheck adds six isolated, tested runtime policy modules: spoken-audio Factory execution, fail-closed legacy ENG/cache replay source handling, Telegram-accepted cached replay delivery evidence, a no-downgrade exact-boundary policy, maximum-quality Factory source acquisition, and selected-format peak-disk validation. The no-downgrade module adds one narrowly scoped canonical Gemini-model regex with dedicated regression tests; the source and disk modules add no regex or editorial postprocess debt.

evidence.quality_contract: Factory selects Russian versus Yandex LiveDub only after Gemini has heard the audio; unknown language fails closed; every proven non-Russian language requires LiveDub; partial Telegram delivery is reported truthfully; legacy ENG cuts cannot silently render the untranslated original; valid analysis cache becomes a no-publication replay; only Telegram-accepted cut videos count as replay success; Gemini must be canonical Pro >=3.1; Whisper must be exact large-v3; configured quality, timing, disk and timeout floors cannot be lowered; fractional Gemini boundaries survive validation; Factory rendering cannot perform a second silence-snap after the final boundary audit; final files are capped from their real probes; Russian and Yandex LiveDub render sources use bestvideo+bestaudio without a 720p/1080p or container-preference ceiling; Gemini audio uses the best native stream, codec-copy remux for supported codecs or lossless FLAC after decoding unsupported Opus/other codecs rather than an intermediate MP3 generation; and maximum-source downloads are preceded by selected-format filesize/tbr estimation plus native/FLAC and separate-stream/merge peak-disk proof on every target filesystem.

regex_evidence.purpose: Validate canonical gemini-<version>-pro model identifiers and reject aliases that merely contain the word pro.

source_quality_evidence.policy: Reset prior yt-dlp format sorting, select bestvideo+bestaudio/best with no resolution ceiling for Russian and Yandex LiveDub sources, obtain Yandex live audio separately and mix it over the unrestricted original, verify the required Russian tail, download bestaudio/best without yt-dlp MP3 extraction, probe every source, remux AAC/MP3/Vorbis/FLAC without re-encoding, convert unsupported codecs to lossless FLAC, and pass the prepared file's real supported MIME into all three Gemini passes.

disk_evidence.policy: Simulate the exact Factory format selector, sum requested stream filesize/filesize_approx or tbr-derived estimates, include native-audio plus stereo PCM/FLAC preparation peak, include separate video/audio streams plus merged output peak, apply conservative unknown-size floors, and require the modeled bytes on every downloads/temp target before media transfer.
